name: ENVE 4210
title: Environmental Engineering Chemistry
description: Quantitative analysis of chemical behavior in environmental systems. Thermodynamics and kinetics of acid/base, coordination, precipitation/dissolution, sorption, and redox reactions. Structures and reactions of organic pollutants. Applications to design of water treatment systems.
requirement_description: CHEM 1128Q or 1148Q and ENVE 2310E or CHEG 2103 and MATH 2410Q; enrollment in the School of Engineering.
